read.thesis: Ally Q2 2026: adjusted EPS $1.21 (+22% YoY), NIM 3.63%, and retail auto NCOs 157bp (down 18bp YoY) with growth guidance raised to 3–5%, though CECL build and a more cautious macro tone temper the read.

triggers.label: Avg earning assets guide 2–4% → 3–5%
triggers.quote: We now expect average earning assets to be up 3 to 5%, versus 2% to 4% previously.

triggers.label: Consolidated NCO guide tightened to 1.2–1.3%
triggers.quote: we are tightening our range on consolidated NCOs, which we now expect will land between 1.2% to 1.3%.

triggers.label: Like-for-like auto pricing raised Q1→Q2
triggers.quote: when we look at our originations on a like for like basis, going from first quarter to second quarter, we increased price.

triggers.label: Auto applications record 4.6M, +17%
triggers.quote: applications reached a record 4.6 million increasing 17% from a year ago

triggers.label: Macro described as dynamic, 'measured' posture
triggers.quote: we are being measured and, I know you have probably heard of a cautious tone from us over the past year and a half

guidance.quote: We now expect average earning assets to be up 3 to 5%, versus 2% to 4% previously.
we are tightening our range on consolidated NCOs, which we now expect will land between 1.2% to 1.3%.

guidance.value: 3.6% to 3.7%, potential to exit above high end
guidance.quote: the guide remains 3.6 to 3.7% with the potential to exit the year above the high end of the range.
we are holding our guide at 1.8% to 2% as you pointed out.

red_flags.label: Corporate finance legacy loan released; reserve coverage down
red_flags.quote: the consolidated coverage rate of 2.49% was down quarter over quarter driven by the specific reserve release in corporate finance

red_flags.label: Consumers triaging bills; delinquencies elevated
red_flags.quote: consumers are basically triaging on a real time basis kind of how they pay every single month

evasions.topic: Retail auto NCO path to 1.6–1.8% through-cycle
evasions.quote: We have not given a timeline to that.
We are not gonna make any particular promises or guidance in terms of the volume of share repurchases
